headline: 58-foot-long dead whale washes ashore on Kuakata beach
summary: A massive whale, estimated to be between 56 and 58 feet long, was found dead on the shores of Kuakata, drawing large crowds of curious onlookers.
details: A massive dead whale has washed ashore on the beaches of Kuakata, Patuakhali. The creature's size is estimated to be between 56 and 58 feet long, according to different reports.
The discovery has drawn large crowds of locals and tourists, who have gathered to see the rare sight of such a large marine mammal on the beach.
Local authorities and experts are looking into the cause of death, as the carcass has already begun to decompose.
Reports from Prothom Alo indicate that the species is a beluga whale, although official confirmation of the species identification has remained pending from marine biologists.
The carcass is currently on the beach, and authorities are working on how to best manage the disposal or study of the carcass.

headline: Storm warning: 20 regions in Bangladesh face storm and rain
summary: Dhaka and 19 other regions are under alert as river ports are issued warning signals due to the risk of thunderstorms.
details: The Meteorological Department has warned of thunderstorms and heavy rain across 20 regions of Bangladesh, including the capital city of Dhaka.
The alert covers a significant portion of the country, with the risk of severe weather expected to hit within the night.
In response to the weather warning, warning signals have been issued for river ports to ensure safety and navigation.
Residents in the affected areas are advised to remain cautious as the weather conditions deteriorate.
